name: Pro Bono
description: When a respected judge's world falls apart overnight, he joins a top law firm's pro bono team — where hope and purpose wait in humble, unexpected places.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Kang Da-wit's rise as a judge comes to a crashing halt after a scandal. A far less glamorous opportunity offers him an unexpected new start.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Initially reluctant to lead a scrappy team, Da-wit takes on a case involving a stolen stray dog — but his unconventional tactics leave everyone stunned.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: While they often clash, Da-wit and the pro bono team begin to find their rhythm. Soon, a young boy arrives as the next client with an impossible request.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: As the case of the boy with a disability unfolds, Da-wit puts the court to the test — while the question of the boy's very worth comes under scrutiny.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Kaya, a foreign bride facing domestic abuse, seeks the team's help in her divorce. But her credibility comes into question amid brutal questioning.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: As Kaya's past comes to light, the pro bono team faces an unexpected turn — pushing Da-wit and his colleagues to fight for her right to stay in Korea.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: When the pro bono team learns they're being disbanded, Da-wit wagers that they can be valuable. Soon, they handle a case involving a popular singer.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: A shocking discovery complicates Eliyah's case, prompting the pro bono team to challenge her contract — even as public opinion turns against her.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: After the pro bono team narrowly avoids being shut down, a shadowy figure approaches Park Gi-ppeum — asking her to file a lawsuit against Da-wit.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Da-wit stands trial as a defendant, facing the very team he has mentored. Meanwhile, both sides hunt for the truth that could bring light to the turmoil.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Da-wit's fate lies in the hands of the pro bono team, whose allegiance begins to waver. But just as peace seems within reach, he faces a new lawsuit.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Da-wit finally brings Oh Gyu-jang, the mastermind behind the corruption of justice, before the court.  Will he succeed in bringing the truth to light?
